reason: I'd maybe poke at the free trial, but paying means putting my clients' posts and brand details into a tool I've never heard of, run by one person. I already draft captions with free tools and send approvals over WhatsApp, and that works well enough.
objection: I don't want client data in a tool I don't know. If it vanishes or leaks, it's my name with the client, and I make about 22k a year, so I can't afford to lose one.
would_change_my_mind: A trial where I only use one friendly client and see real captions that sound like them, plus proof from other freelancers I know who use it. Also a Solo plan that is clearly cheaper than 15 and a monthly cancel that is truly one click.
